'''Dalin Forgewright''' is a [[human]] found at the [[Greymane Wall]] along the border of [[Gilneas]] and [[Silverpine Forest]].

Dalin fled from Lordaeron when the plague struck, taking his love with him. When he came upon the refugees at the Greymane Wall, he felt it his duty to succor them, sending his wife on to Hillsbrad. For his charity, [[Carendin Halgar]] sends young [[Horde]] [[warlock]]s to harvest his heart, along with the heart of [[Comar Villard]], so that they may learn to summon a [[succubus]].<ref>{{questlong|Horde|20|Hearts of the Pure|class=warlock}}</ref>

==Abilities==
* '''Heal'''
* '''Power Word: Fortitude'''
* '''Renew'''

==Objective of==
* Drops [[Dalin's Heart]] for the quest {{questlong|Horde|20|Hearts of the Pure|class=warlock}}.

==Notes==
* Carendin Halgar also briefly shows his projection during the quest.
